newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - June 25.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Wednesday and main factors likely to affect trading:

* The market will be prone to short-term plays as investors await the release of second quarter corporate earnings, said BPI Securities Corp. BPI Securities advises selective accumulation on fundamental issues.
* The main index will move within the 2,750 to 2,850 range in the coming days with inclination towards the 2,850 resistance.
* On Wednesday, the Philippine composite index closed 9.62 points up at 2,818.27 points.
* The Dow Jones on Wednesday ended 153.80 points higher at 7,758.06. PLDT's ADR closed steady at $62 1/2.
* The Philippine peso closed slightly lower at 26.374 to the dollar vs 26.373.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was steady at 15.0625 percent.
* Philippine interest rates could rise as the government tries to fend off any spillover from the crisis facing the Thai baht, bankers told Reuters on Tuesday.
* PLDT could see slightly higher profits for the first half of the year despite redundancy expenses and delays in introducing a new tariff structure, analysts said on Tuesday.
* Sinophil Corp said it ws negotiating with other companies to open four casinos in the Philippines and abroad.
* PureFoods Corp had formed a joint venture with two other food companies to take on the exclusive franchise of Burger King restaurants in the Philippines, Burger King Corp said.
* The APC Group said its telecom unit Philippine Global Communications Inc (Philcom) had been buying shares of mobile phone Pilipino Telephone Corp from the stock market.
* Ayala Corp said its board of directors approved the declassification of its A and B shares that would result in one price.
